text:
Ravi: FYI courier just dropped off a giant framed print and a bakery box addressed to 'Maya Lin' (visiting for @Aisha). There's no bell and the frame is taller than the door. Any volunteers for escort + a place to stash it?
Frontdesk Bot: Package logged as PRCL-6112. Visitor checked in: Maya Lin. Temporary badge printed and on hold. Photo from courier uploaded to front-desk thread.
Aisha: That's my cousin 60a The print is for the kitchen wall; I can pick up at 5pm. Can we keep the box of assorted pastries refrigerated?
Marco: I can help with the frame — it needs two people. There's an equipment ladder but better to use the goods lift. Suggest staging the print in Conference Alcove C (out of sight) and pastry in Fridge 2.
Elena: Heads up the print has a glass face. Please tag "DO NOT STACK" and avoid the rolling cart; I'll bring moving straps.
Ravi: Plan: two people + straps to move frame -> Alcove C, pastries -> Fridge 2 (label PRCL-6112). Badge for Maya expires 6:30pm. Post a sticky on the alcove door.
Frontdesk Bot: Reminder: Locker C2 available for small items (code `7744`). PRCL-6112 labeled with "Maya Lin - fragile glass".
Marco: Frame moved to Alcove C, strapped and propped on foam blocks. Pastries in Fridge 2, labeled. Left photo at front desk.
Aisha: You rock thank you!! Tell Maya the cinnamon buns survived 36a
Elena: Added sticky: "Pickup: Aisha, 5:00pm; do not tilt".
Ravi: Closing thread once Aisha confirms pickup. Huge thanks to Marco and Elena. :clap: 
Aisha: Confirmed pickup at 5:05pm. Everything intact. :tada:
